original_query: Are technical skills more important for top management or lower-level management?

confirmed.answer_text: Top management relies most on conceptual skills, then human skills, and least on technical skills.; Lower-level management relies most on technical skills, then human skills, and least on conceptual skills.
confirmed.summary: The chart illustrates the relative importance of conceptual, human, and technical skills across three management levels: top, middle, and lower-level management. The importance is indicated by the color intensity of the bars, with darker red indicating higher importance.
key_facts: Top management relies most on conceptual skills, then human skills, and least on technical skills.
Lower-level management relies most on technical skills, then human skills, and least on conceptual skills.
